players.product: Power-first greenfield AI data-center campuses on 15-year triple-net leases (River Bend LA for Anthropic; Beacon Point TX) - ex-Bitcoin-mining platform (American Bitcoin affiliate)

quarterly_data.signal: Q1 2026 results (CFO): revenue grew approximately 226% year-over-year to $71 million, driven primarily by the compute (Bitcoin mining) segment, and gross margins expanded to approximately 64% from 14%; the net loss of $253.1 million was driven primarily by unrealized mark-to-market losses on digital assets. Segment mix: compute segment revenue more than tripled to approximately $66 million from $16.1 million (margin approximately 67%); power segment revenue was $3.7 million after the February 2026 sale of the Far North power portfolio; Digital Infrastructure segment revenue was $1.3 million, flat year over year, and management expects that segment to become the primary growth driver beginning in Q2 2027 as the River Bend and Beacon Point phase 1 data halls come online.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue $71 million (approximately 226% YoY); gross margin approximately 64%; compute segment approximately $66 million; Digital Infrastructure $1.3 million

quarterly_data.signal: Beacon Point (1 gigawatt Texas campus) phase 1 commercialized on the day of the call: a 15-year triple-net lease for 352 megawatts of IT capacity (500 megawatts of utility capacity) with a high investment-grade counterparty (management defines this as AA- or higher), $9.8 billion of expected base term contract value inclusive of a 3% annual escalator, and three five-year renewal options taking potential contract value to over $25 billion. Roughly half the campus remains available for future commercialization; the tenant has a ROFO on the remaining capacity plus short-term exclusivity. Asked whether the tenant is Anthropic/Google/Fluidstack, the CEO said 'It is not. It is net new growth.' The tenant is unnamed by policy going forward.
quarterly_data.figure: 352 megawatts of IT capacity; 500 megawatts of utility capacity; $9.8 billion base term contract value; over $25 billion including renewals

quarterly_data.signal: NVIDIA is Hut 8's design and technology partner on Beacon Point: the facility was redesigned for next-generation chip architecture, lifting IT capacity from 224 to 352 megawatts within the same land and utility footprint (about 300 MW utility became 500 MW utility in a single building) and raising base term contract value by $3.6 billion from $6.2 billion to $9.8 billion. The CEO called it 'one of the most advanced data centers with 0.5 gigawatt capacity in a single building on Earth' and said Hut 8 now has designs for two of the three largest chip offerings in the market.
quarterly_data.figure: IT capacity 224 to 352 megawatts; contract value +$3.6 billion (from $6.2 billion to $9.8 billion)

quarterly_data.signal: River Bend financing closed after quarter end (CEO and CFO):three and a quarter billion dollars of 16 and a half year fully amortizing senior notes at approximately 95% loan to cost and a 6.192% coupon, non-callable for life, rated BBB- by S&P and Fitch; described as the first investment-grade construction bond for a single-sponsor data center project, multiple times oversubscribed. Hut 8 recovered $184 million of deployed equity at closing; only 2.5% of the total equity investment was deployed before lease signing. Earlier options considered were a construction loan at approximately 85% loan to cost and SOFR plus 225, then approximately 90% at SOFR + 240. Beacon Point financing will also prioritize a structure non-recourse to the parent.
quarterly_data.figure: 6.192% coupon; approximately 95% loan to cost; BBB-; $184 million of deployed equity recovered

quarterly_data.signal: Contracted portfolio economics (River Bend + Beacon Point phase 1 leases): approximately $16.8 billion of contracted revenue is expected to flow through as NOI over the initial 15-year terms, and the contracted portfolio is expected to generate approximately $1.1 billion of annual NOI; under the triple-net structure the only Hut 8 cost is the structural framework of the building and landscaping, so revenue drops to NOI at 'above 99.9%'. Take-or-pay, no termination for convenience.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately $16.8 billion contracted revenue; approximately $1.1 billion of annual NOI; above 99.9% NOI conversion

capex.metric: contracted revenue expected to flow through as NOI over the initial 15-year terms of the River Bend and Beacon Point phase 1 leases

quarterly_data.signal: Build cost and delivery: Beacon Point capex is guided to the same range as River Bend, $9 million-$11 million per MW. 100% of long lead time equipment is ordered and all major contracts are signed for both campuses (partners named on the call include Jacobs and Vernova, with contractual delivery obligations mirroring customer commitments). Hut 8 targets Q2 2027 for the initial data hall delivery at River Bend, with the data center coming online between Q2 and the end of 2027. At River Bend, Entergy is building the switch yard for the initial phase of 330 MW of utility, expected ready in the next couple of months, ahead of the data center; Hut 8 is working with Entergy Louisiana and IPP partners on additional generation.
quarterly_data.figure: $9 million-$11 million per MW; Q2 2027 initial data hall delivery; 330 MW of utility (River Bend initial phase)

quarterly_data.signal: Pipeline and campus phasing: Hut 8 is advancing 8.4 GW of development pipeline, aiming to convert it into contracted opportunities. At Beacon Point, 700 megawatts of the campus is available in Q1, with the additional 300 megawatts in the 24 months thereafter. The CEO also cited over half a gigawatt of behind-the-meter projects and over half a gigawatt of front-of-the-meter projects (behind-the-meter: King Mountain 280 megawatts, Vega 205 megawatts, Granbury 300 megawatts managed for Generate Capital) and sees more M&A opportunities in early- and later-stage sites.
quarterly_data.figure: 8.4 GW development pipeline; Beacon Point 700 megawatts available in Q1 plus 300 megawatts in the following 24 months

quarterly_data.signal: American Bitcoin (ABTC) relationship: Hut 8 manages 700+ megawatts of infrastructure for American Bitcoin, leasing on 5-year triple-net leases at a yield on cost of about 20%-25%; the Bitcoin demand path let Hut 8 develop Beacon Point without speculative risk before an AI tenant was signed. Balance sheet: approximately $1.3 billion of cash in Bitcoin at quarter end; the $200 million Coinbase facility was refinanced into a 364-day FalconX note at a 7% coupon (from 9%), freeing approximately 3,300 Bitcoin.
quarterly_data.figure: 700+ megawatts managed for American Bitcoin; yield on cost about 20%-25%; approximately $1.3 billion of cash in Bitcoin

contracts.signal: Asked for an update on the Anthropic/Fluidstack relationship, the CEO said: 'we have a very strong relationship. We're talking about opportunities, and we're talking about their obviously massive demand profile. They obviously were a part of, and Google were part of kind of the deal last week that we did on the bond structure' (the River Bend senior notes financing). He stressed tenant diversification, and confirmed the new Beacon Point tenant is not Anthropic ('It is net new growth').
contracts.type: relationship update / River Bend financing participation
